stem: What percentage of children diagnosed with transient synovitis are ultimately found to have Perthes disease?
explanation: 5% is the approximate proportion of children diagnosed with transient synovitis who are ultimately found to have Perthes disease.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because a small minority of children with transient synovitis are later diagnosed with Perthes disease.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because this is far higher than the proportion associated with subsequent Perthes disease.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because about half of children with transient synovitis do not go on to Perthes disease.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because one-quarter is higher than the expected proportion.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 10% is still higher than the usual estimate of 5%.

source.hint: It is a relatively small percentage associated with patients who have persisting symptoms.
